Bursting with flavor, gourmet vegetarian meal!
Mar 2026 • Solo
"Hum" is an experience, flavors you've never had before, gorgeous presentation and all vegetarian! I started with a hibiscus fig cocktail, paired with a starter of glazed eggplant in holy basil sauce with rice-paper-wrapped seared king oyster mushrooms. Exquisite! Then a pomelo-passionfruit salad, presented in a dainty passionfruit cup. I chose their signature crunchy sticky-rice with Sapa mushrooms main dish, which was accompanied by lightly pickled ginger & lemongrass, and kumquats. So satisfying! And for dessert jujube jam rolls with tart homemade key-lime ice cream and fresh, sugar-glazed tamarind.... this is seriously my new favorite dessert! Such a delight.

Guest Service Manager
Dear Ms. Laurel M,

Thank you for taking the time to visit Hum and share such a vivid and delightful review. We’re truly happy to know that your experience with us felt like a flavorful culinary journey filled with new and memorable tastes.

Your detailed descriptions of each dish, from the hibiscus fig cocktail and the glazed eggplant with holy basil sauce, to the pomelo-passionfruit salad, the signature crunchy sticky rice with Sapa mushrooms, and the dessert with key-lime ice cream, mean so much to our team. At Hum, we hope every plant-based dish brings harmony in flavor and beauty in presentation, creating a dining experience that delights both the palate and the senses.

We’re especially glad to hear that the dessert has become your new favorite. We would love to welcome you back to discover even more inspiring flavors on your next visit.

When I was traveling alone in Vietnam and got quite bored with Vietnamese food, this one, which happened to be near my place of stay, was recommended by ChatGPT. Wonderful
Dec 2025 • Couples
I am vegetarian. We had had the a la carte in the other restaurant (which also does meat dishes) and loved it so much we wanted to try the signature menu. We absolutely loved it. We were looked after by the excellent and very charming Hang Nguyen. She explained all the dishes to us and was very knowledgeable . We also had a nice encounter with the customer care manager who checked we were happy with everything. About the food: Each dish showcased the different vegetables beautifully. The flavours were very subtle and with our British palate I would say you have to eat slowly and consciously to appreciate the flavours and the details that have gone into each dish. I would describe the whole meal as light, but sufficient, and we appreciated this as there is nothing worse than feeling utterlly stuffed; I didn't wake up hungry. It is expensive, but only relative to Vietnamese prices and certainly still cheap vs. the UK, and think it is a fair price for the ingredients that have been very carefully sourced, the quality of the dishes and the whole experience. We would most definitely return if we had the opportunity.

Style over substance
Nov 2025 • Couples
Hum signature is a tasting menu, which highlights a number of vegetables we’d not really come across. Each dish is presented with detailed background to the ingredients by an enthusiastic waiting team. 

Whilst the design of the meals is impressive and there are a number of courses - we were still hungry at the end. The first three courses are served together and are thimble sized. For the price, this is not good value for money and as a result we would not recommend. It would not be hard to increase the quantity that was on offer. Some dishes, especially the last dish (I think white lotus) were completely bland. 10 out of 10 for effort but more style over substance. The main Hum restaurant is excellent and offers much better value for money. The ambience in the latter is also nicer.
